{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA: {len(completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue_completed:.2f}")"}
